title: Double Klondike
selectSource: Select a card to move (top of a tableau column or the waste)
selectDestination: Select a destination (a tableau column or a foundation)

tutorial.board: Klondike played with two decks (104 cards). There are 9 tableau columns, 8 foundations (two per suit), and a stock.
tutorial.stock: Click the stock to turn over three cards. When the stock is empty you can recycle the waste back into it.
tutorial.rules: Build the tableau down in alternating colours and the foundations up by suit from Ace to King. Move all 104 cards to the foundations to win.
tutorial.actionButtons: Buttons for draw, hint, undo, give up and more.

frontendHint.dklondikeToFoundation: This card can go to a foundation
frontendHint.dklondikeToTableau: This card can move to another column
